decision_title: Architecture Decision: Managed Auth vs In-House Custom OAuth2
objective: Determine optimal identity strategy balancing launch timeline, enterprise compliance, and long-term TCO.

criteria.name: Time to Market & Delivery Speed
criteria.description: Ability to ship production-ready authentication within 6-week beta window

criteria.name: Security & SOC2 Type II Readiness
criteria.description: Pre-certified compliance controls, MFA, Passkeys, and SAML audit trails

criteria.name: Total Cost of Ownership (Years 1-3)
criteria.description: SaaS licensing fees vs engineering maintenance salaries and infrastructure

criteria.name: Architecture Flexibility & Portability
criteria.description: Freedom from vendor lock-in and customization of custom claim models

alternatives.name: Option A: Managed Identity Provider (Clerk / Auth0)
Option B: In-House Custom OAuth2/OIDC Microservice

winner.name: Option A: Managed Identity Provider (Clerk / Auth0)
winner.recommendation: Adopt Managed Identity Provider for launch, using an internal provider-agnostic JWT claims adapter to eliminate vendor lock-in risks.
